label: Natillas
note: In Spain a pouring custard of milk, sugar, vanilla, egg yolks and cinnamon, often with a María biscuit on top; in Colombia natilla has no eggs

about.text: A Spanish custard of milk and eggs, thinner than flan and without caramel.
